title: Bacalhau à Brás
description: A traditional Portuguese cod dish made with shredded cod, onions, potatoes, and scrambled eggs. This recipe is a staple in Portuguese cuisine.
instructions: Shred the cod into small pieces and rinse with cold water.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until they start to brown.
Add the shredded cod and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until heated through.
Crack the eggs into the pan and scramble them with the cod mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
